verdict.rationale: NVIDIA claims DLSS Multi Frame Generation boosts FPS by generating up to five frames per rendered frame. TechPowerUp's independent review confirms 'good gaming performance' but notes a smaller-than-expected gen-over-gen gain. Nothing in the pack shows 4K resolution or high-refresh frame rates specifically, and the Hacker News benchmarks are compute, not games. missing for 10: independent 4K game benchmark numbers, evidence of sustained high-refresh frame rates at 4K, vendor 4K-specific performance claims to corroborate

support.subject: As a gamer, this card drives high-refresh 4K gaming — vendor performance claims corroborated by independent game benchmarks

citations.quote: new DLSS Multi Frame Generation boosts FPS by using AI to generate up to five frames per rendered frame
The main upgrade is GDDR7, giving 960 GB/s of bandwidth, a 34% increase over the RTX 4080.
